heading: Monday, February 23, 2026
topLine: Gauss completes Lean formalization of Viazovska's sphere-packing proofs in dimensions 8 and 24.

items.headline: Gauss completes Lean formalization of Viazovska's sphere-packing proofs in dimensions 8 and 24
items.summary: Math, Inc. announced on Lean Zulip that its Gauss agent had proved all remaining results for the 8-dimensional sphere-packing theorem in about five days. Gauss built on a blueprint and codebase from the human team led by Sidharth Hariharan and Maryna Viazovska. On 2 March, Math, Inc. said Gauss had also formalized the 24-dimensional case, over 200,000 lines, in about two weeks without a blueprint. The human team checked that the definitions were unchanged and only classical axioms were used, ran lean4checker, and is refactoring the code.
